design.line_encoding: Five local dark arrows, spatial membrane/nuclear boundaries and an unarrowed separator/footer. No global approach sequence or shared inevitable outcome.

design.transferable_principle: Separate intervention entry levels into peer panels, retain local intervention alternatives and membrane–cytoplasm–nucleus coordinates, and bind conditions to each proposed programme. A shared aim does not require a cross-panel arrow or guaranteed common outcome.
